enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. At 06:00, begin to stir. Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms. Sit up. Reach for phone. Press button to stop alarm. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing and getting ready for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Toast pops up. Spread butter on toast. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Final preparations and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work clothes. Lay on bed. Take off sleepwear. Put on work clothes. Button shirt. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to desk. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place laptop inside. Place notebook. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Reply to message. Put phone away. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Talk to doctors. Assist with procedures. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Complete paperwork.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Reply to message. Put phone away. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Place in sink. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Find show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Scrub hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Check email. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Comment. Open video streaming. Watch video. Pause. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply. Put down phone. Continue watching video. Open game. Play game. Save game. Close game. Shut down computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply.
